# NFL Daily — 2026-08-08 (Past 1 day(s))

## Summary
- 08/07: Titans G Peter Skoronski agrees to a four-year, $100M extension ($88M guaranteed), becoming the NFL's highest-paid guard. [Rapoport](https://x.com/RapSheet/status/2085807580451119260)
- 08/07: Bills agree to a four-year, $78.4M extension ($46M guaranteed) with RG O'Cyrus Torrence. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/49552831/bills-agree-4-year-784m-deal-rg-ocyrus-torrence)
- 08/07: Colts CB Cam Taylor-Britt suspended one game without pay for violating the NFL's personal conduct policy, will miss the season opener. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/49555724/colts-cam-taylor-britt-suspended-1-game-violating-personal-conduct-policy)
- 08/07: Raiders QB Kirk Cousins and DE Maxx Crosby scuffled late in Friday's practice before teammates separated them. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/49555077/raiders-cousins-crosby-scuffle-friday-practice)
- 08/07: Chiefs coach Andy Reid says QB Patrick Mahomes is unlikely to play in next week's preseason opener despite a full camp. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/49554483/reid-mahomes-unlikely-play-chiefs-preseason-opener)
- 08/08: Pro Football Hall of Fame enshrines its 2026 class — Drew Brees, Roger Craig, Larry Fitzgerald, Luke Kuechly and Adam Vinatieri — Saturday in Canton. [Schefter](https://x.com/AdamSchefter/status/2086050160845459711)
- 08/08: Eagles OT Lane Johnson says this is likely his final season, with retirement coming in 2027. [McLane via Rapoport](https://x.com/RapSheet/status/2086118249692090659)
